rules_review: The official complete UNL-042/219 face agrees with the preserved raw and effective facts. No errata or alternate printing discrepancy is known in the accepted dated inventory.
A finalized Hand origin independently draws once per execution. Hidden, Flow from Trash and instructed Banish origins do not draw, including Repeat.
A departed, protected or newly replayed target does not prevent an eligible independent draw. A counter stops both instructions.
Stun leaves readiness, Might and damage unchanged; already-stunned units remain legal choices. End-of-turn cleanup clears Stun.

Hidden costs one Any Power at a controlled empty slot, is not a Play, and cannot be played that turn. Its later Reaction waives the base cost but retains additional costs and field-local target checks.
First-burnout draw completes before ordinary victory checking. A repeated draw is a new sequence; an empty deck and trash can cause the second-burnout retry to win immediately under rule 432.3.c.1.
Exact-payment refusal restores the draft and resources; completion retains the original Hand fact. Choosing friendly Irelia still produces her normal choose trigger.
The API retains facedown identity privacy and exposes the finalized public play origin to both viewers.
findings_resolved: Early fixtures used the First Mate unit instead of a pending spell, omitted Banish-offer promotion, or entered a contested field too early. Corrected fixtures use Discipline, promote the offer, and open the showdown after hiding.
The burnout assertion expected 9 points; the empty-deck retry produces 10 before immediate victory. The expectation was corrected against 432.2–3, without changing engine behavior.
The first UI build used assert_eq on a Selection type without Debug. A matches assertion fixes the test helper; all four final native click runs pass.
The priority notes incorrectly described Hunters' Circle as a missing admission. It is already battlefield 7; a renewed interaction audit remains queued.
limitations: This is one card-pool addition, not a new verified tournament preset or best-of-three sideboarding.
The last full Nix package acceptance remains commit5250302; this acceptance uses native Rust builds.
The dated accepted inventory remains in use while the duplicate live publisher printing is unresolved.
This focused review does not establish complete Standard card or interaction coverage.
